phase3_findings.description: the inlined --head "$(git branch --show-current)" hides the inner substitution's failure from the outer ||; git prints empty on a detached HEAD, degrading the query to an unfiltered repo-wide gh pr list --state open that exits 0 and adopts an arbitrary unrelated PR
the REFUSED arm's comment claims it 'stops with a breadcrumb' but the shell only echoes to stderr — no stop, no durable record; the run falls through to the PR-link resolution
bare .[0].number is nondeterministic on a head with two open PRs — the exact hazard the guard's own comment cites; §1.4 uses sort_by(.createdAt) | last
the comment references a `-z` test that does not exist; routing is via ${EXISTING_PR-REFUSED}
the adopt arm's 'converge' claim and the 'freshly-created' wording rest on the unscoped gh pr view the guard condemns
the adopt arm does not verify the adopted PR closes this issue or targets the right base
the three-arm selection has no driven arm matrix; CLAUDE.md asks branch-selecting inline shell to be extracted into a scripts/ helper the suite can drive

fix_decisions.claim_text: the adopt arm should verify the adopted PR closes this issue and targets $BASE
fix_decisions.evidence: AC7 scopes the §3.1 edit to detecting the already-open PR and skipping re-creation; adding closes-issue/base validation is a new behavior beyond the issue's spec. Filed as follow-up work rather than widened here.

parking_evidence.basis: beyond AC7's stated scope for the §3.1 coupled edit
parking_evidence.failing_input: an unrelated human-authored open PR sharing the adopted head branch

fix_decisions.claim_text: extract the §3.1 three-arm selection into a scripts/ helper and drive the arm matrix from the suite
fix_decisions.evidence: a new bundled helper needs a capability-profile token grant, and per CLAUDE.md's grant-timing bootstrap a grant added inside a PR is in-PR-inert (trigger-time-resolved, post-merge-only) — so the extracted helper could not be invoked by the very runs this PR ships. Two behavioral pins now cover the guard's operative query form and its own-statement branch read.

parking_evidence.basis: the extraction requires a capability grant that is in-PR-inert by the documented grant-timing bootstrap
parking_evidence.failing_input: a reordered or deleted arm in the three-arm selection

phase3_findings.description: the §3.1 adopt arm resolves PR_URL through the unscoped gh pr view the guard condemns — the substitute-the-number instruction covers PR_NUM only, so the workpad link can carry the adopted number with a different PR's URL

the empty-branch pin's mutation swaps in $(true), leaving the -z guard intact — it flips RED by literal removal, not by re-introducing the regression, i.e. a removal pin wearing a behavioral-pin comment

§2.0 onward-routing skips §2.4 Test and the §2.3.x sweeps on an all-ticked Plan, which cannot prove they ran — they execute after the last --tick-plan and are recorded by §2.5's 'code + sweeps' Progress tick
the §3.1 create arm has no failure route; a failed gh pr create degrades into a run with an empty PR link
--record-classification uses an explicit value check, not argparse choices; the added prose attributes the wrong mechanism
'unconditionally says dispatch code-explorer / dispatch code-architect' is overbroad — the architect dispatch is Path B only
§2.0's failed-read breadcrumb directive ships no literal fence, unlike every sibling durable-record directive
